incremental_mvp.candidate_generation_note: historical q=0 / q=1 weights reused (bitwise verified); no quantization run

estimated_fresh_deployment_2_layers.method: historical 4-layer Hessian + GPTQ seconds / 2 (L8, L16 only; layers have equal shapes); the 'other' term (E3 scoring / weight IO / PPL checks) is excluded
estimated_fresh_deployment_2_layers.note: the layer-wise baseline needs the same two candidates and the same tuning-split layer evaluation as the hybrid (its per-expert scores come for free from that pass), so both cost ~2x one GPTQ run + validation; a joint profiler pass could share the Hessian forward but not the GPTQ solves

storage.offline_peak_storage: both candidates (2x) must be held until selection

inference.expected_change: none (one existing weight set per expert; same kernels/format)
